summary: Frontend-only verification of the updated Testimonials (Results) section on the Cherry Tree Agency landing page. Confirmed exactly 4 cards render with correct name/company/location, posters load with naturalWidth>0, clicking each card opens the modal and mounts an HTML5 <video> element with the expected /testimonials/<name>.mp4 src, and the close button dismisses the modal cleanly between cards. Additionally verified all 4 .mp4 and 4 .jpg assets are served via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with HTTP 200 and content-type video/mp4 / image/jpeg. No JS console errors on load or during the flow.
verified_checks: Card1 = Stephen Cruey / Apex Bath Remodeling / Cleburne, TX; Card2 = Emilio Talavera / Roofing Monkeys / Toronto, ON; Card3 = Clint Roberts / Prime Baths of New Mexico / Albuquerque, NM; Card4 = CFC / CFC / United States
All 4 posters load: apex-baths.jpg, roofing-monkeys.jpg, prime-baths.jpg, cfc.jpg (each naturalWidth=1920)
testimonial-modal-close dismisses modal between openings without errors
Screenshot during Card1 open confirmed the <video> was actively rendering the first frame with native controls (poster/frame visible)
All 4 .mp4 URLs at {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/testimonials/*.mp4 -> HTTP 200, content-type: video/mp4
0 JavaScript console errors and 0 pageerror events during full flow
notes_on_readystate: In the headless Playwright test the <video> element's readyState/networkState were sampled immediately after mount and showed 0/3 for all 4 cards; however a visual screenshot from an earlier run clearly shows the video rendering the first frame with native controls and duration UI. Per the review request, actual playback is not required — only that the correct src is mounted. All 4 srcs mount correctly and are served with valid video/mp4 responses.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoTestimonials.jsx is clean; TESTIMONIALS array correctly uses source.kind='mp4' for all 4 items and VideoPlayer's mp4 branch renders <motion.video src controls autoPlay playsInline> as expected.
Minor: Consider adding preload="metadata" (currently default) or preload="auto" on the <motion.video> so posters/first frame appear faster on modal open in browsers that defer network activity.

Minor: The DialogClose is absolutely positioned at -right-3 -top-3 which sits slightly outside the DialogContent; on smaller viewports this can clip. Not blocking; behaviour verified on desktop 1440x900.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonials section is fully verified with 4 self-hosted MP4 cards. All posters/videos serve HTTP 200 from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/testimonials/. Cards use data-testid=testimonial-card-{1..4}; modal uses testimonial-modal and testimonial-modal-close; <video> is inside testimonial-video wrapper. Note: card display text is rendered in CSS uppercase — use case-insensitive matching when asserting names.
